meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控面板:安装 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard 包,并把一个每 60 秒推送 JSON 快照的 pusher 接进启动流程,面板展示 agent 组、会话、频道、用户、token 用量和实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板,或运行 /add-dashboard 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控面板
say.note: 会安装 npm 包并把 pusher 接入 main()

say.text: 把 dashboard 从 NanoClaw 里移除
say.note: 删除新增文件和环境变量后重新构建

say.text: 把 .env 里的 DASHBOARD_PORT 改成 3200
say.note: 改完需重新构建并重启服务

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: it installs the @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard package and wires in a pusher that posts JSON snapshots every 60s, showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage and logs.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, or run /add-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the npm package and wires the pusher into main()
Deletes the added files and env vars, then rebuilds
Rebuild and restart the service afterwards
